description: This file defines the 'TeamStatistics' class and related UI component classes for the Mattermost system console's reporting section, specifically for team statistics. It includes methods for interacting with and verifying UI elements in end-to-end tests.

classes.name: TeamStatistics
classes.description: Represents the team statistics section in the system console reporting UI, providing methods to interact with and verify UI elements related to team statistics.

classes.name: StatCard
classes.description: Represents a statistic card UI component within the team statistics section.

classes.name: ChartSection
classes.description: Represents a chart section UI component within the team statistics section.

classes.name: TableSection
classes.description: Represents a table section UI component within the team statistics section.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the team statistics container and header are visible.

methods.name: selectTeam
methods.description: Selects a team from the dropdown by team name.

methods.name: selectTeamById
methods.description: Selects a team from the dropdown by team ID.

methods.name: getSelectedTeam
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected team name from the dropdown.

methods.name: toHaveTeamHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the team statistics header displays the expected team name.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the StatCard component is visible.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the text content of the StatCard's value element.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the ChartSection component is visible.

methods.name: hasNoData
methods.description: Checks if the chart has no data message.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the TableSection component is visible.
